Package dev.px.core.event

Interface EventBus

All Known Implementing Classes:
CoreEventBus
public interface EventBus
Dispatches events to Subscribe-annotated methods.

Implementations must be safe to post to from any thread and must tolerate subscribe/unsubscribe calls made from inside a handler.

  • Method Details

    • subscribe

      void subscribe(Object listener)
      Registers every Subscribe method on listener, including inherited ones. Registering the same instance twice is a no-op.

    • unsubscribe

      void unsubscribe(Object listener)
      Removes every handler belonging to listener.

    • isSubscribed

      boolean isSubscribed(Object listener)

    • post

      <T extends Event> T post(T event)
      Posts an event to every matching handler, in descending priority order.
      Returns:
      the same event, so callers can post and inspect in one expression: if (bus.post(new PlayerJumpEvent()).isCancelled()) return;

    • on

      <T extends Event> Subscription on(Class<T> type, Consumer<? super T> handler)
      Registers a standalone handler for one event type.

      The returned Subscription is the only way to remove it, so hold on to it for anything that outlives the caller.
